audit_location_requires_org.name: audit_location_requires_org
audit_location_requires_org.value: "audit_events"."location_id" IS NULL OR "audit_events"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

lifecycle_location_requires_org.name: lifecycle_location_requires_org
lifecycle_location_requires_org.value: "lifecycle_events"."location_id" IS NULL OR "lifecycle_events"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL

demo_run_terminal_check.name: demo_run_terminal_check
demo_run_terminal_check.value: ("organization_demo_runs"."status"='ACTIVE' AND "organization_demo_runs"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "organization_demo_runs"."close_reason" IS NULL) OR ("organization_demo_runs"."status"='CLOSED' AND "organization_demo_runs"."close_reason"='USER_EXIT' AND isfinite("organization_demo_runs"."closed_at") AND "organization_demo_runs"."closed_at">="organization_demo_runs"."created_at") OR ("organization_demo_runs"."status"='EXPIRED' AND "organization_demo_runs"."close_reason"='EXPIRED' AND isfinite("organization_demo_runs"."closed_at") AND "organization_demo_runs"."closed_at">="organization_demo_runs"."expires_at")

learning_session_time_check.name: learning_session_time_check
learning_session_time_check.value: isfinite("learning_sessions"."started_at") AND (("learning_sessions"."status"='ACTIVE' AND "learning_sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("learning_sessions"."status"='COMPLETED' AND "learning_sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("learning_sessions"."completed_at") AND "learning_sessions"."completed_at">="learning_sessions"."started_at"))

transaction_control_reconciliation_statu.name: transaction_control_reconciliation_status_outcome_check
transaction_control_reconciliation_statu.value:
(
        (
          "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."status" = 'OPEN'
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."outcome" IN ('AMBIGUOUS', 'PARTIAL_FAILURE')
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."resolved_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."status" = 'RESOLVED'
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."outcome" IN ('CONFIRMED_SUCCESS', 'CONFIRMED_NO_EFFECT')
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

transaction_control_reconciliation_idemp.name: transaction_control_reconciliation_idempotency_binding_check
transaction_control_reconciliation_idemp.value:
(
        (
          "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."idempotency_key" IS NULL
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."idempotency_key_source" IS NULL
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."payload_hash" IS NULL
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."retry_horizon_ends_at" IS NULL
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."idempotency_retention_until" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."idempotency_key_source" IN ('CLIENT_SUPPLIED', 'SERVER_DERIVED')
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."payload_hash" IS NOT NULL
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."retry_horizon_ends_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."idempotency_retention_until" IS NOT NULL
          AND "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."idempotency_retention_until" >= "transaction_control_reconciliation_records"."retry_horizon_ends_at"
        )
      )

identity_application_session_terminal_ti.name: identity_application_session_terminal_timestamp_check
identity_application_session_terminal_ti.value:
(
        ("identity_application_sessions"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "identity_application_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "identity_application_sessions"."expired_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("identity_application_sessions"."status" = 'REVOKED' AND "identity_application_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "identity_application_sessions"."expired_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("identity_application_sessions"."status" = 'EXPIRED' AND "identity_application_sessions"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "identity_application_sessions"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
      )

identity_invitation_terminal_timestamp_c.name: identity_invitation_terminal_timestamp_check
identity_invitation_terminal_timestamp_c.value:
(
      ("identity_invitations"."status"='PENDING' AND "identity_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "identity_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "identity_invitations"."expired_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("identity_invitations"."status"='ACCEPTED' AND "identity_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "identity_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "identity_invitations"."expired_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("identity_invitations"."status"='REVOKED' AND "identity_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "identity_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "identity_invitations"."expired_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("identity_invitations"."status"='EXPIRED' AND "identity_invitations"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "identity_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "identity_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
    )

identity_password_reset_token_terminal_t.name: identity_password_reset_token_terminal_timestamp_check
identity_password_reset_token_terminal_t.value:
(
      ("identity_password_reset_tokens"."status"='ACTIVE' AND "identity_password_reset_tokens"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "identity_password_reset_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "identity_password_reset_tokens"."expired_at" IS NULL)

      OR ("identity_password_reset_tokens"."status"='EXPIRED' AND "identity_password_reset_tokens"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "identity_password_reset_tokens"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "identity_password_reset_tokens"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
    )

identity_credential_hash_check.name: identity_credential_hash_check
identity_credential_hash_check.value: ((("identity_credentials"."credential_type" IN ('PASSWORD','PIN')) AND ("identity_credentials"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL)) OR (("identity_credentials"."credential_type" = 'OAUTH_LINK') AND ("identity_credentials"."password_hash" IS NULL)))
